audit.whatIsWrong: First item and 2+ items were given to Illaoi while whys[5], whys[6], spikes[2] and spikes[3] all say the opposite ('force the poke war now', 'you win the splitpush 1v1', 'she has no dash or gap-closer to reach you'). The already-audited Illaoi-side page flipped both rows to Kayle. Level 6 was Skill on this page and Illaoi on hers.
audit.why: Illaoi has no dash and no gap-closer; once Kayle is ranged with Nashor's she cannot be caught. Before that, level 6 only lets Kayle survive — a committed fight in her tentacle field is still hers.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Illaoi, First item and 2+ items flipped to Kayle, in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved and the level-6 why-lines rewritten. Levels 1 to 5 left with Illaoi.
sources: enemyKit: no dash on Illaoi's kit apart from Harsh Lesson's leap to a target

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit is named as the tracked cooldown in ten places with no number given anywhere, and the level-6 phase had none for Divine Judgment.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 — a missed grab means a 16s window at rank 1 where Kayle can farm freely, which is the only reason 'wait for it to be down' is actionable. Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 16s written into dosFull[0].d, phases[5].why and breakdown.cooldowns; 160s into phases[4].why and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent. Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever a tentacle damages a champion, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades — the itemization line only said 'his healing'. And Harsh Lesson is a 4s leap that resets her auto-attack, so the wind-up is the cue to step out, not the cast.
audit.why: Both listed in _missing for this matchup; both are in Riot's own text. A 4s reset is the fastest thing in her kit and the page never mentioned it.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names the tentacle heal; breakdown.cooldowns now states Harsh Lesson is a 4s auto reset.
sources: enemyKit P text, W cd 4 and autoReset flag

notes: Rows 4, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic group to match the Illaoi-side audit, which explicitly recorded that Kayle must own First item and 2+ items when this side was written. Levels 1-5 left with Illaoi even though the packet chart calls levels 3 and 4-5 Skill — the Illaoi-side page has them as Illaoi and the two directions must agree; the whys for those rows ('stepping into tentacle reach still loses the fight') support Illaoi anyway. diffRating moved off 8.5/10, which described a losing lane against a 58.23% win rate. Several full-layer strings still call Kayle 'he/him' (tradeGood, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].d, report[12].t, report[2].t) — the Illaoi-side audit flagged the same pronoun sweep and I left it alone rather than spend the length band on fields with no factual change.
